executive_summary: The broader US market experienced a historic tech-led surge following Nvidia's unanimous reinstatement of Jensen Huang as CEO, igniting a massive relief rally across artificial intelligence hardware, software, and semiconductor supply chains. The Nasdaq and S&P 500 recorded their strongest single-session gains in over a year, lifting both megacap tech core watchlist names and oversold high-beta market movers. While macro sentiment is overwhelmingly risk-on, investors should remain attentive to emerging Congressional scrutiny over tech governance and selective capital raises in biotechs like Kymera.
